# A wonderful place to live  A beautiful community to visit

## 40 bedrooms

### En-suite bathrooms

All our rooms are on the ground floor and are thoughtfully designed with profiling beds, modern furniture and private bathrooms to ensure comfort, safety and convenience for our residents.

[![Care Quality Commission Report](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/CQC-24-03-08.png)](https://www.cqc.org.uk/location/1-113560755)

## Over 80%

### Staff retention rate

Our dedicated team thrives in a supportive, stable and rewarding environment. When people join us, they stay because we value our team as much as we value our residents.

## 40 years

### Family owned and run

We’ve built a reputation for providing exceptional care in a supportive and welcoming environment. Our long standing family ownership reflects stability, trust and commitment to exceptional care.

> _A family run home, an exceptionally caring team_

![](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/the-band-green.jpg)

> “We are always talking about the happy days that my Mum spent at Aldbourne.”
>
> Sue, Daughter

![](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/anh-painting-crop.jpg)

## We are a family run home in the heart of a thriving Wiltshire community

Our single level home sits at the centre of Aldbourne, a picturesque and historically significant village embraced by the Marlborough Downs of North Wiltshire. Our team, residents and families actively engage in the local community life and benefit from the strong support of nearby professionals and villagers.  This close-knit connection bring a sense of belonging and enriches the lives of everyone involved, creating a welcoming and supportive environment.

We take great pride in providing high-quality care that enhances the well-being and dignity of our residents. Our dedicated team places kindness and respect at the heart of every interaction, ensuring that each resident feels valued and cared for. We are committed to creating a safe and comfortable environment where our residents can thrive, surrounded by compassionate professionals who prioritise their needs.

Visiting families can immerse themselves in the beauty and history of Aldbourne, a village rich in charm and character. They can enjoy a relaxing lunch at one of the welcoming local pubs or cafés or admire the stunning architecture of the 15th-century church. For those who love the outdoors, a peaceful walk along the Ridgeway, leading to the ancient Bronze Age barrows, offers breathtaking views. History enthusiasts can explore the sites where the “Band of Brothers” were stationed or stand in the very spots where Doctor Who filmed memorable scenes. Aldbourne offers a perfect blend of scenic beauty, fascinating history, and vibrant culture, creating an unforgettable experience for families visiting their loved ones.

[Download our Leaflet](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Aldbourne-Nursing-Home-Leaflet.pdf)

![Outside Aldbourne Nursing Home with children from the school.](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/outside-with-school-visit.jpg)

![A stroll in the garden](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/garden-stroll.jpg)

* * *

> “She is looked after with compassionate dedication from a very stable team who not only know her, but make an effort to know us too.”
>
> Elspeth, Daughter

![school children playing with the residents](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/school-visit-balloons.jpg)

## We are here to support your family, bringing joy to every visit

Central to our home’s purpose is the importance of supporting our residents’ families in what can be difficult times. We achieve this by truly caring, building meaningful relationships between our staff and residents and also the wider community of Aldbourne. This sense of belonging is vital to the happiness and fulfilment of those in our care and their wider family members of all ages, enriching every visit to our beautiful community.

[Enquire](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/enquire/)

![A visit in the garden](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/garden-visit.jpg)

![Having fun doing chair exercises](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/chair-exercises.jpg)

> “I felt I would like to volunteer at ANH after seeing the wonderful care and support afforded to my father whilst a resident.”
>
> Kath, Relative and Volunteer

# Careers

> “The most impressive thing from a GP point of view is how organised the staff are and how well they know the patients. This makes it so much easier for us as doctors to care for the patients because we can trust the nursing staff.”
>
> Dr. Muller, Ramsbury Surgery

[Work with us](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/apply/)

## Working at Aldbourne Nursing Home

We are always looking for kind compassionate people, to join our team. Whether you are just starting your career or looking to make a meaningful change, we welcome individuals who are passionate about making a difference in the lives of our residents.

### No Experience? No Problem!

We provide a comprehensive training program designed to give you all the tools and knowledge you need to succeed. Our experienced team is here to guide you every step of the way, ensuring you feel confident in your role and supported as you grow. We both acknowledge and reward staff that go the extra mile to improve the experience of residents at our home.

### QCF in Health and Social Care

For those looking to further their qualifications, we support employees in obtaining their QCF in Health and Social Care. We’ll help you build your expertise and provide the training needed to earn a recognised qualification while working in the field.

### Why Work with Us?

- Long-Term Career Satisfaction: We’re proud that most of our team have been with us for years. This speaks to the supportive and rewarding environment we’ve built, where our staff feel valued, fulfilled, and satisfied in their roles.
- Professional Development: We’re committed to your career growth, offering ongoing training, internships, and opportunities to advance within the organisation.
- A Supportive Environment: We prioritise a positive and collaborative atmosphere where everyone is valued and encouraged to thrive.
- Competitive Benefits: Enjoy a range of benefits designed to support your well-being both at work and outside of it.

If you’re compassionate, dedicated, and ready to make a difference, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a team that’s making a real impact in the lives of others.

[Submit your details](https://aldbournenursinghome.com/apply/)

# Discover Quality Care Home Living

## Making a Difference

Everyone ages. It is an inherent property of life. As our bodies and minds change over time, we need to adapt to these changes by modifying our decisions and actions. At Ashburton House we are here to support you and your loved one's through this process. The later years of life can be especially challenging, but the dedicated and professional team at Ashburton House are here to help. At Ashburton House, we listen to all of our residents in order to understand their needs and limitations and discuss and formulate assisted living solutions. We work with our clients, families and friends to customise options that will help people to lead the lives they want.

Our Community Awaits

Braceborough Hall Care Home is situated in Braceborough, a delightful South Lincolnshire village approximately 6 miles from Stamford, Bourne,  Market Deeping and around 14 miles from Peterborough.

​

We opened our doors as a care home in 1985 and have been managed by the current owners since inception. An early Victorian house we are situated in 2 acres of lawns and trees in a small village providing a calm and peaceful environment. The property has been extensively modernised in recent years but in a sympathetic way to ensure that it retains its original character.

The overriding aim of the home has always been to provide the highest level of personal care to its clients paying careful attention to their personal needs. We are registered for 25 residents and whilst there has been the temptation to extend the home to cater for additional numbers, this has been resisted on the basis that we wish to retain the home from home feeling and also because such a move could impact negatively on the standard of care provided. We believe that this makes us more attractive compared with some of the larger homes.

We welcome both permanent and respite care and our fees are set very competitively.

# Carrick House

# Nursing Home

Carrick House enjoys a central yet tranquil location in a leafy suburb of Ayr. The grand Georgian house boasts a purpose-built  extension with wheelchair accessible gardens which are enjoyed by residents.

[Find Out more](https://carrickcare.co.uk/carrick-house/#carrickintro)

## Your individual needs are central to everything we do…

We are confident Carrick House will be the safe secure and happy home you and your loved ones are looking for.

We celebrate life and the seasons in a way that encourages independence, emotional wellbeing, participation and sociability. Our aim is to ensure that Carrick House becomes your home from the moment you walk in the door.

[VIEW OUR BROCHURE](https://carrickcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Carrick-House-for-screen.pdf)

## Settling into your new home

You can be confident in choosing Carrick House as your home from home, we are committed to quality of care and creating a safe and happy environment grounded by years of dedicated service.

Once you have decided to make Carrick House your home, you will be allocated a key worker, who will work closely with you and your family to create a personal care plan and ensure you are well looked after from the start.

You are encouraged to personalise your room by bringing your precious possessions, pictures and furniture to your new home.

Our chef will get to know you and any dietary requirements or allergies, and just as importantly, what you like to eat.

Our dedicated team is committed to the wellbeing of our residents and how best to care for your needs in a sensitive, caring and responsive way. Your key worker and Activity Coordinator will get to know you, your story and what you like doing.

Our activities are varied, planned monthly for our our residents to enjoy an active, stimulating programme of events. Regular day trips are something we enjoy at Carrick House and we are always open to input from residents.

[Schedule a Free Visit](https://carrickcare.co.uk/carrick-house/#visit)

# High standards of nursing, convalescence and respite care

**Cumloden Manor** is an attractive purpose-built care home set amid picturesque greenery in Old Minnigaff, [Newton Stewart](https://www.great-value-websites.com/newton-stewart), in the heart of ‘Bonnie Galloway.’

The home is owned by Caroll Pagan and was registered in 1988 to provide a high standard of care for the elderly.

However, **Cumloden** **Manor** also caters for younger, physically disabled clients and offers convalescence and respite care.

Our fully trained nurses, senior carers and carers are on duty throughout the day and night to ensure that our residents receive an excellent quality of care, delivered in an efficient and unobtrusive manner, respecting privacy and dignity at all times.

A full range of visiting professionals includes the doctor, dentist, optician and physiotherapist. We also have massage sessions twice a month through the Red Cross.

We endeavour to create a relaxed atmosphere at **Cumloden Manor** with a friendly ambience that allows residents to enjoy the feeling of a ‘home from home.' Residents can come and go as they please and friends and relatives are welcome at any time as there are no restrictions.

Call us today on 01671 403903 for more information or [**email us**](mailto:info@cumlodenmanor.co.uk).

# Welcome to Downside House Residential Care Home

**[![CQC Inspected and Rated](https://www.downsidehouseresidentialcarehome.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/cqc.png)](https://www.cqc.org.uk/location/1-123395077) DownSide House provides a comfortable, homely and caring environment, allowing for a maximum of self choice and a minimum of restriction, with the need for privacy and dignity being of paramount importance.**

Set atop the unique hillside architecture of the Victorian historical town of Ventnor, the house offers a peaceful yet convenient location from which to enjoy the south east coast of this beautiful Island.

[CQC Inspection Report – Click Here](https://www.cqc.org.uk/location/1-123395077)

- A fully – renovated mid 19th Century Ventnor town house with stunning Sea and Downs views.
- A 150 ft landscaped garden and south-facing roof terrace. Two brand new and cosy lounges with television and recreational facilities.
- All rooms with en suite facilities.
- Passenger lift and front ramp access.
- 24 hour care provided by dedicated, qualified staff.

### _“At DownSide we nurture respect, choice and independence…_

### _where everyone is encouraged to feel at home amongst their own personal belongings.”_

# Help and Advice

**Finding the ideal care home is a daunting task but seeking help and advice can make the process easier and help you to make the best decision possible for yourself or a loved one.**

Our care home manager Mrs Alison Overton is very happy to meet people who are looking for care and understands what a difficult time it can be for the whole family. Alison is always happy to talk to anyone considering different care options and to answer any questions you may have about life at the home, care packages and care in general.

# News

# GenScript Biotech Expands to the United Kingdom with New Offices  and Logistics Center    _Oxford expansion supports U.K. customers with fast_ _turnaround time on research products, and local_ _technical support_

Dec 16, 2021

**Oxford, ENGLAND, Dec. 16, 2021** –
[GenScript Biotech Corp.](https://www.genscript.com/), a global biotechnology
group, announced today that it has expanded operations in the United
Kingdom with new offices and a fully functional logistics center in
Oxford. The facility will support U.K. customers with fast delivery
of high-quality products and services for expediting research, as
well as technical support.


"The U.K. biosciences sector is one of the leading innovation hubs
in the industry worldwide, particularly when it comes to
advancements in cell and gene therapy," said Aaron Qian. "We are
excited to support our regional customers with their needs as they
scale up from R&D through GMP, and we look forward to becoming an
even more active member of the U.K. biosciences community."


The new facility features certified cold chain storage and
transportation for receipt and delivery of samples and products with
rapid turnaround time. The trained logistics team will also help
with customs clearance after Brexit. In addition to the logistics
center, the new GenScript office will house sales and account
managers specializing in field technical support. The office will
employ approximately 50 people, and is expected to double over the
next two years.


GenScript maintains sales, research and development and
manufacturing operations in the U.S., Asia and Europe. The company
has more than 100,000 customers in more than 100 countries
worldwide.


## About GenScript Biotech Corporation

GenScript Biotech Corporation (Stock Code: 1548.HK) is a global
biotechnology group. Based on its leading gene synthesis technology,
GenScript has developed four major platforms, including the global
cell therapy platform, the biologics contract development and
manufacturing organization (CDMO) platform, the contract research
organization (CRO) platform and the industrial synthesis product
platform.


GenScript was founded in New Jersey, US in 2002 and listed on the
Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2015. GenScript's business operation
spans over 100 countries and regions worldwide, with legal entities
located in the U.S., Mainland China, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore,
Netherlands and Ireland. GenScript has provided premium, convenient,
and reliable products and services for over 100,000 customers.


GenScript has a number of intellectual property rights and technical
secrets, including more than 100 patents and over 270 patent
applications. As of December 31st, 2020, GenScript's
products and services have been cited by 52,500 peer-reviewed
journal articles worldwide.


For more information visit [www.genscript.com](https://www.genscript.com/).

# Important: Ongar Health Centre Update

The practice has been going through a period of transition with a number of our team leaving and new team members joining. We are aware that this has caused some problems in accessing appointments but want to reassure patients that we have been actively recruiting and we will soon be back to our expected resource levels on a consistent basis.

Dr Johnston has left the practice for family reasons and Amanda Tanner (ANP) has also decided to move on. Our cohort or resident doctors have now completed their training with us and so are moving on and we have just taken in four new doctors to train under the supervision of our Practice Partners.

Dr Prusova is returning from maternity leave on 29th September 2026 and Dr Freya Smith is joining us as a salaried GP on 5th October 2026. We are onboarding a new ANP who will replace Amanda and we hope they will be in place in early October. We are also recruiting for additional GP and ANP hours over and above what we used to have to improve appointment availability further and we plan to have these roles filled soon in anticipation of the increased demand for our service in the winter months.

We would like to thank all of our patients for your patience and understanding whilst we have been navigating this challenging period.

## Important: Making an appointment has changed

## Total Triage - a new way of booking appointments at Ongar Health Centre

Ongar Health Centre has now adopted a total triage system. This means that every request for help will first be reviewed by a doctor, who will then decide the most appropriate way to help you based on the urgency of the request. The doctor will also decide which healthcare professional or service is best suited to address the issue. This system is encouraged by the NHS and is already in use at many GP practices.

**Patients have three main ways to contact the surgery:**

- **Online using our new booking system called Anima via our website** The quickest way to contact Ongar Health Centre with medical or administrative queries is by submitting an online request through **your surgery’s website** or through the **NHS app**.
- **By phone**: Patients who cannot go online can call the surgery, and a Receptionist will assist them in filling out the Anima form.
- **In person**: Patients can visit the reception, where a Receptionist will help them with an Anima form. Regardless of the contact method, all requests must go through Anima to ensure it is fair and safe.

**You can still call in to make an appointment with a Nurse, HCA and Clinical Pharmacist in the usual method.**

**About Role**

The Sales Director will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding market presence, and building strategic partnerships for Telth Healthcare. This role requires a results-driven leader with expertise in international care plans, digital sales and network expansion. The position requires frequent travel, strategic planning and collaboration with multiple departments.

**Core Duties**

- Develop and execute aggressive sales strategies to promote and sell international care plans across target markets.
- Drive online sales initiatives and lead digital marketing campaigns for India and the UK.
- Expand and strengthen the Harley network in key regions including Delhi and Mumbai.
- Build and manage a robust agent network to ensure wider market reach and customer acquisition.
- Partner closely with HR to recruit, train, and manage sales and agent teams.

- Maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders to ensure business sustainability.

- Excellent leadership, team management and network-building skills.
- Ability to create and deliver training programs for agents and the internal teams.
- Exceptional communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
- Willingness and flexibility to travel internationally as needed.
- Familiarity with market expansion strategies and multi-channel sales.
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Management or related field.
- Additional certifications in Digital Marketing, International Sales or Healthcare Management are a plus.

## SolarGain Software





SolarGain operates as a standalone software platform, whether data is collected by Above, your own teams, or third-party providers. It combines workflows, QA, inspections, digital twin technology and operational data into a single platform built specifically for utility-scale solar.









[Learn more](https://www.abovesurveying.com/solargain)

## Thermographic Inspection





Thermographic inspection helps solar asset owners detect hotspots, string faults, and module defects early, so they can reduce downtime, protect yield, and plan maintenance more effectively.









[Learn more](https://www.abovesurveying.com/thermographic-inspection)

## Digital Construction Management





Improve solar asset quality during construction with digital construction management that connects aerial oversight, field-based quality control and a component-level digital twin.

### Support the Shop Local Movement: Join Our Bridge Team

1,425+ indie shops need your help to make their communities better. Join us to make a difference.

~ Jason Solarek / Founder & CEO


![Bridge retailers and brands at the Rosse showroom in Atlanta.  Jason Solarek, Bridge CEO and Founder, shown on far right.](https://www.shoplocal.org/img/AboutBridge_image.jpg)

_Bridge [retailers](https://www.shoplocal.org/retailers-members.cfm) and [brands](https://www.shoplocal.org/smart-brand-members.cfm) at the [Rosse showroom in Atlanta](https://rosse.myshoplocal.com/)._

* * *

##### 2 Job Postings:

#### [Account Manager/Sales Manager](https://www.shoplocal.org/news.cfm/22164/Account-Manager-Sales-Manager-)

Good news: Shop Local is hiring. We're looking for:

- Sales Managers.
- Account Managers.

If you know someone who may be interested, please contact us.

We are experiencing notable growth: 1,400+ retailers now use our platform. We're driving double-digit revenue growth for our merchants.

**Qualifications**

We are looking for motivated people that:

- Wish to see indie stores, brands, and reps succeed.
- Support the shop local movement.
- Are comfortable with computers, websites, and social media.
- Are comfortable with Excel.
- Are comfortable training others.
- Are comfortable using services such as GoToMeeting.com and Zoom.
- Are comfortable calling prospective businesses and sharing how an online service works.
- Are comfortable writing content including: client communications, project instructions, articles, and help documents.
- Experience with product management a plus, including via Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, BigCommerce, or Magento.
- Past experience with Shop Local is a plus but not required.

**Hours**

- The roles are freelance and entail 30-40 hours per week.

**Location**

- The roles can be conducted remotely (e.g. from a home office).

**Compensation**

- Pay for roles is higher than industry norms.
- Shop Local employees are hired as Independent Contractors and must provide their own equipment.

**About Shop Local**

- Shop Local is the leading e-commerce platform for indie gift stores.
- We help retailers, sales reps, and brands in the U.S. and Canada.
- Learn more about Shop Local: [https://www.shoplocal.org](https://www.shoplocal.org/)

**Employment Type**

Full-time

**Apply:**

Send your resume to [jobs@bridge.org](mailto:jobs@bridge.org)

* * *

#### [Bridge Is Hiring Developers](https://www.shoplocal.org/news.cfm/22184/Bridge-Is-Hiring-Developers)

Work With the Nation's Leading Brands and Indie Shops to Support Main Street

Shop Local is a fast-growing e-commerce and gift registry platform providing services to leading independent retailers and premium brands. Based in New York, NY, Shop Local is seeking candidates to support the existing software and build out new services that will change the retail industry.

We are a small dev team who works in a full stack fashion. There are many opportunities to sharpen your skills as well as explore developing new skills in programming and application spaces using a variety of technologies. Dev team collaboration is central to the way we work and we're dedicated into fostering a diverse and inclusive environment focused on the success of our customers and our Shop Local platform.

Shop Local has an opening for an entry level web developer to update the existing code base and write new applications. We are seeking candidates who are proficient in:

- HTML5
- CSS / CSS frameworks (Bootstrap)
- Responsive web design
- jQuery
- JavaScript (ES6+ preferred)
- ColdFusion / CFML experience
- MySQL
- iOS - Swift / SwitftUI

**Responsibilities**

- Assist in design, development, testing, and maintenance of web applications utilizing ColdFusion, JavaScript, and Swift related technologies.
- Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
- Revise, edit, proofread, and optimize web content.

**Qualifications**

- At least 1 - 2 years of experience using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Proficiency in at least one server-side technology (ColdFusion (preferred), Java, PHP, NodeJS, Python).
- Ability to multi-task, organize, and prioritize work.

**Pluses**

- Familiarity with mobile app development and responsive design.
- ColdFusion knowledge / certification.
- Familiarity with e-commerce API development and integration.
- Familiarity with iOS application development with Swift / SwiftUI.

**Benefits**

- 100% remote.
- Flexible schedule.

**Job Type**

- Full-time.
- Part-time.
- Contract.

**Location**

- Can work remotely.

**Hours**

- 20-40 hours per week.

**Pay**

- Per experience.

**Our Vision**

Shop Local aims to be the leading platform for running a retail business, from the store's website to its POS system. We are doing this because we believe that existing software charges business owners too much money and requires too much time, and leaves the owners feeling isolated and alone. Our software brings business together leveraging their collective power to reduce costs and save time.  We also help business owners feel happier.

Shop Local believes that helping local businesses is a key route to helping our communities. We believe that indie shops increase employment and help collect local taxes to support for our schools, roads, and public services.

**About Shop Local**

- Shop Local is one of the leading e-commerce platforms for brick-and-mortar stores to run their online operations. Nearly 1,400 stores across the United States, Canada, and Caribbean use Shop Local.
- Shop Local membership has grown by double digits for the last consecutive 7 years.
- 18 of the top-20 selling home goods brands use our advertising service, including Le Creuset, Baccarat, and Versace.
- AmericanExpress called Shop Local's network 'Facebook for the retail industry.'
- Shop Local is owned and managed by Bridge.

A well-known pastry chef from Hong Kong started a small bakery in the outskirt of China Town Toronto with his two young sons. They started to produce fine European pastries and cakes with high quality ingredients with traditional French and European style.

Through out the years, the two brothers branched out into Scarborough, North York, and Richmond Hill. They have developed the small bakery into fine pâtisserie, gourmet food restaurant.

65 years have passed, Maxim's never gave up maintaining its direction to use fine quality ingredients for their cakes, pastries, and gourmet dishes. The cakes and pastries from Maxim's are made 100% fresh and made from real ingredients (no cake mixes). For the gourmet dishes, they use only high quality steaks like Certify Angus Beef, U.S choice beef, New Zealand lamb, or supreme grade chicken. Also, the sauces for our menu from top to bottom are made from scratch everyday.

Continuing the family tradition, Maxim's continues to produce fine dishes, fine pastries and fine cakes to ensure your stay at our place is a special moment in your life.

Academic Curriculum

We provide the latest F&B industry best practices and trends to supplement the academic curriculum in secondary schools and vocational institutes in Hong Kong.

Students can structurally acquire values, knowledge and skills for career development and enhanced employability.

![](https://www.maxims.com.hk/media/career-content/new_career_icon_2.png)

Student Ambassador Programme

The customised ambassador programme “Maximizers” offers students a simulated trainee journey focusing on job-readiness education, exposure to business, and hands-on working experience.

Students will put their learning into practice from the simulated trainee journey on campus as an ambassador of Maxim’s.

![](https://www.maxims.com.hk/media/career-content/new_career_icon_3.png)

Earn & Learn Programme

“Earn and Learn” is a programme combining both part-time job and internship opportunities.

Students can acquire operation working experience as a paid part-timer. In the meantime, the accumulated part-time hours can convert into an internship opportunity in office with on-the-job training and work assignments.

![](https://www.maxims.com.hk/media/career-content/career_icon_4.png)

Trainee Programme

“Drive Your Way” is a tailored programme that allows graduates to shape their future by designing their own trainee journey according to their career preferences.

The 1-year trainee journey allows graduates to build business and management capabilities through job rotation, overseas exposure, strategic projects and learning sessions.

## About This Place

Located at 790-792 Leeds Rd in Bradford, **Mughals Restaurant and Sweet Centre** is a vibrant culinary gem that masterfully captures the rich essence of Pakistani and South Asian cuisine. This beloved establishment invites food lovers to indulge in a diverse menu that effortlessly blends traditional favorites with comforting classics, creating an unforgettable dining experience for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

Step inside Mughals, and you're immediately embraced by a warm and inviting atmosphere where attentive, smiling staff make you feel right at home. The recently revamped space boasts a stylish yet cozy ambiance - perfect for laid-back breakfasts, lively family gatherings, or intimate dinners. The genuine hospitality noted by visitors like Parvez Iqbal and Pete Smith reflects in every interaction, making each visit special beyond just the delicious food.

The menu is a treasure trove of tantalizing dishes that awaken your senses. Start your morning with a hearty _English Breakfast_ or dive into traditional delights like _Chana Puri_ and _Halwa Puri_, where fragrant spices and fresh ingredients come alive with every bite. The _Butter Chicken_ stands out with its rich, velvety sauce enveloping tender chicken, while the _Fresh Lamb Handi_ offers an intoxicating blend of aromatic spices simmered to perfection.

Mughals perfectly balances robust flavors with comforting textures - think luxuriously soft garlic naans pairing impeccably with their mouthwatering lamb handi or the delightfully crisp _Paratha with Desi Omelette_. For those craving something heartier, the _Mughal Sizzler Mixed Grill_ is an irresistible offer, serving up an array of succulent meats that celebrate South Asian grilling mastery.

Dessert enthusiasts will find pure bliss in classics like _Jalebi_, its sweet, golden spirals delightfully crisp yet juicy, or the indulgent _Falooda_, a refreshing symphony of textures and flavors. Don’t miss the unique _Lahore Restaurant Vinella Ice Cream with Fudge Brownie_ \- a decadent twist on a beloved treat. And for a truly cultural experience, sample the soothing _Kashmiri Pink Tea_ that warms the soul with every sip.

Beyond the amazing food, Mughals impresses with its versatility - serving as an event venue renowned for its accommodating and attentive service. Celebrations like the family birthday party hosted by Naz & Ali reveal Mughals’ commitment to flawless hospitality and thoughtful details, creating memorable occasions with ease and grace.

It’s no surprise that patrons like Sid Ahmed praise Mughals for its exceptional cleanliness, bustling yet professional environment, and excellent value, especially with enticing offers like 2-for-1 on main courses every Tuesday. Whether you’re craving a quick breakfast or a sumptuous feast, Mughals ensures an authentic and richly satisfying experience that keeps visitors coming back time and again.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Outstanding Experience at Moghal Restaurant – Leeds Road, Bradford We visited Moghal Restaurant on Leeds Road today, and from the moment we stepped inside to the moment we left, the hospitality was absolutely exceptional. A huge thank you to Manager Waqar and the brilliant staff - Adam, Kushi, and Jawad - for making our visit truly memorable. Their warm welcome, attentive service, and genuine care made us feel valued throughout the entire meal. We ordered the Chicken Chilli Karahi and the Chicken Steak, and both dishes were spot on. The flavours were rich, fresh, and perfectly balanced - you could really taste the quality and passion in the cooking. The presentation, portion sizes, and taste were all top-tier. What really sets Moghal apart is the atmosphere and the people. The team went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect, and their professionalism combined with friendly service made the experience even better. We will definitely be making Moghal our go-to restaurant whenever we visit the city. Highly recommend to anyone looking for amazing food and outstanding service.

## We like to describe One Aldwych as the hotel for Londoners at heart, wherever they might be from.

![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/one-aldwych-london-map-1400x928.png)

#### Our Neighbourhood

Our home is at the centre of Covent Garden, London’s most exciting neighbourhood. For the curious minded, you have access to the finest entertainment and cultural adventures, positioned as we are on the doorstep to galleries, museums, West End theatres and the famous Royal Opera House.

[Discover More](https://www.onealdwych.com/inside-one-aldwych/our-neighbourhood)

![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/6530fd98da2ad540654e2c4d_Homepage-Culture-AldwychCuratorsMay2021105-1024x576-1-1.jpg)

#### Our Recommendations

Consider our resident team as the friends with all the best recommendations. Brunch, ballet, boutiques, cocktails, exhibitions, and the little-known corners of the city that we think you’ll love.

[Discover More](https://www.onealdwych.com/inside-one-aldwych/our-neighbourhood)

![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/PH013_OA2021_DELUXE-004-1400x928.jpg)

### Suites & Bedrooms

Designed to be more than just a place to lay your head, each bedroom and suite at One Aldwych embraces a contemporary, stylish character ready to host, cocoon and enchant. All with the sense of modern, independent Britishness that we like to champion.

[Discover More](https://www.onealdwych.com/suites-bedrooms)

![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/PH013_OA2021_SOMERSET-SUITE-014_W4K-1400x928.jpg)

### Signature Suites

Each of our four Signature Suites has unique features and bespoke touches inspired by the space and surrounding views, as well as artwork from One Aldwych’s extensive private collection. If you admire a particular piece, there will be a story behind it that we will be all too happy to share!

[Discover More](https://www.onealdwych.com/suites-bedrooms/#signature-suites)

![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/PH013_OA2021_SUPERIOR-001_W4K-1400x928.jpg)

### Bedrooms

Our Superior and Deluxe Bedrooms are a celebration of warm, modern British design with a timeless appeal.

[Discover More](https://www.onealdwych.com/suites-bedrooms/#bedrooms)

![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/PH013_OA2021_ALDWYCH-CORNER-009_W4K-1400x928.jpg)

### Suites

We have twelve beautiful and spacious suites each with their own defining characteristics and potential configurations to suit your personal set-up. If you are unsure about what will suit your needs best, please get in touch and we can advise on the perfect spot for you.

[Discover More](https://www.onealdwych.com/suites-bedrooms/#suites)

## Inside One Aldwych

Our cultured, independent hotel at the beating heart of London life.

[Learn about One Aldwych](https://www.onealdwych.com/inside-one-aldwych)

- [![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/file-2025-01-23T092928.793-760x580.jpg)\\
**Our impact**\\
\\
As London’s first luxury hotel to achieve B Corp accreditation, our impact on the world is incredibly important to us.\\
\\
Learn about our impact](https://www.onealdwych.com/inside-one-aldwych/our-impact)
- [![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/656f59398c0fcbdbff7a8a55_History-Alamy-Image-to-2024-B0KJ8B-765x500-1-760x500.jpeg)\\
**History**\\
\\
Stepping into our lobby is to step into a moment in history, dressed up in style. Built in 1905 as the home of the Morning Post, we like to think it still inspires spirited conversation and connection.\\
\\
Discover our history](https://www.onealdwych.com/inside-one-aldwych/history)
- [![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/file-2025-01-23T100042.030-760x580.jpg)\\
**Covent Garden**\\
\\
Ideally located in the heart of Covent Garden, we are steps away from extraordinary dining, countless theatres and shopping, with cornerstones of British culture within easy reach.\\
\\
Explore Covent Garden](https://www.onealdwych.com/inside-one-aldwych/our-neighbourhood)
- [![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/file-2025-01-23T100445.641-760x580.jpg)\\
**News**\\
\\
Our story is very much our own to write. Dip into what’s going on in and out of One Aldwych in our online journal inspired by our newspaper heritage.\\
\\
Read our news](https://www.onealdwych.com/news)
- [![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/6530fd92934f3eadecae347e_Andre-Wallace-Girls-Head-0009_W4K-1-760x580.jpg)\\
**Our Curated Art Collection**\\
\\
Our hotel is home to a 400-strong collection of contemporary art and sculptures, conjuring the inspirational atmosphere of a gallery, mixed with the curated eccentricities of a private home.\\
\\
View our gallery](https://www.onealdwych.com/inside-one-aldwych/art)
- [![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/file-2025-01-23T091247.497-760x580.jpg)\\
**Flowers at One**\\
\\
We are extremely lucky to have Mark Siredzuk as our resident florist. His beautiful creations are at the centre of our dynamic lobby, and you’ll see his exceptional work featured throughout the hotel.\\
\\
Meet Mark](https://www.onealdwych.com/inside-one-aldwych/flowers-at-one)

## Offers

![](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Bayeux-Tapestry-England-about-AD-1072%E2%80%9377.-Photo-%C2%A9-La-Fabrique-de-patrimoines-en-Normandie-Antoine-Cazin.-1-1-1400x928.png)

[![Monet and Renoir's iconic La Grenouillère reunited side by side for the first time in almost twenty years.](https://www.onealdwych.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/La-Grenouillere-760x580.jpg)\\

\\
**A Sunday Roast**\\
\\
Sunday afternoons in Covent Garden were made for this – enjoy an indulgent roast at One Aldwych.\\

**Time to Give Thanks**\\

[![Virindhu](https://www.virundhurestaurant.com/img/logo.svg)](https://www.virundhurestaurant.com/index.php)

# Discover Virundhu  A SRI LANKAN FEAST

Virundhu combines a relaxed atmosphere with authentic Sri Lankan food, using only the freshest
spices and ingredients available.

![Authentic food](https://www.virundhurestaurant.com/img/about-delicious.jpg)

We are delighted to offer the people of London and further afield an insight into the global Sri Lankan cuisine that our family know and love.

Our Sri Lankan born chef Ravi has individually selected every dish on our menu and mastered the amazing
flavours that each of them evokes. From his very own homemade curry powder to his signature sauces, are
all uniquely masterfully crafted with a twist that will leave your taste buds craving more.

Sri Lanka has a rich culinary heritage dating back over two thousand years, the tropical island of
paradise offers a truly exquisite cuisine. Our menu offers you an extensive vegetarian selection as well
as delicious meat, fish and seafood dishes, with aromatic spices and sauces cooked to perfection.

![Dine](https://www.virundhurestaurant.com/img/dine-image.jpg)

Virundhu welcomes you to Sri Lankan cuisine where authenticity meets quality. We invite you to indulge an intoxicating spread of Sri Lankan cuisine from our restaurant in North West London. The authenticity and sublime flavours of our dishes attract lovers of exquisite cuisine from all over London.

All our dishes are freshly cooked with spices from Sri Lanka and a combination of flavours that are a treat to the taste buds! The real distinction of Virundhu’s food is not the individual spices used but the prominence with which they’re featured.

[Take a Virtual tour](https://www.virundhurestaurant.com/coming-soon.php)

![Authentic food](https://www.virundhurestaurant.com/img/delicious-menu.jpg)

Our extensive menu offers you a beguiling mix of Sri Lanka's favourite dishes and our head chef Ravi's family recipes and signature creations.

[View Our Menu](https://www.virundhurestaurant.com/menu.php)

## reserve a table  Make a Reservation

[reserve now](https://module.lafourchette.com/en_GB/module/739974-346de)

## Reviews

Great authentic experience of Sri Lankan cuisine - with intense flavours
from starters to dessert. If you go you must try the devilled lamb
starter, mutton kothu and Ceylon chicken curry. Make sure to leave some
room as the homemade Watalappan cake (together w/ homemade vanilla ice
cream) is a great way to finish the meal. Will go back soon to try some
of the other dishes on the menu.

Gary, Google Reviews

I have visited some of the best Michelin star Sri-Lankan restaurants in
London and this little gem deserves a spot right next to them! The food,
service and ambience is exquisite! We were served by Jay and he couldn't
not have been more attentive, friendly and helpful. A huge thank you to
him, his manager and the lovely lady who served us! Everything the team
recommended was simply delicious! Finally, we have a decent place to go
to in Eastcoat!

Trip Advisor

My husband and I went for dinner at Virundhu last week and we absolutely
loved the food. There was a good variety of Sri Lankan dishes to choose
from. The staff were very helpful and the service was great. The
cocktails were fantastic and had a Sri Lankan twist to them. We had the
coconut mojito which complimented our meal really well. We most
definitely will be visiting Virundhu again. Highly recommend!

Abi, Google Reviews

[![Tripadvisor](https://www.virundhurestaurant.com/img/trip.png)](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Restaurant_Review-g7380842-d12507013-Reviews-Virundhu-Pinner_Greater_London_England.html)
